count_definitions.complete: Reviewer completed an assessment and disposition of the item; can include supported uncertainty or a reported gap. Does not mean the candidate satisfied it.
count_definitions.assessed: Examined against admitted artifact and available relevant primary evidence.
count_definitions.unassessed: Not examined before completion/deadline. Unknown source/process support is instead explicitly assessed-unknown.
count_definitions.artifact_content_complete: Required delivered content adequately present; for optional discovery records, candidate presence is counted separately from a completed review disposition. Optional omissions are not unmet original feature requirements.
count_definitions.axes: Shared item IDs are counted within each applicable axis; axes overlap and must not be added as disjoint populations.

items.text: Polynomial order zero chooses order automatically

items.text: Minimum of three active points for both proposed models
items.conditions: Similarity mathematically needs two noncoincident points, affine three noncollinear points. Three for similarity is a conservative product threshold, not a mathematical minimum.
